common.title: Title:
home.mario_kart_game_browser: A Mario Kart Game for browser
home.computer_version_famous_racing_game: A computer version of the famous racing game by Nintendo.
home.this_game_completely_free_does: This game is completely free and does not require any downloads. All you need is a web browser!
home.try_fastest_while_avoiding_items: Try to be the fastest while avoiding items!
home.race_all_56_tracks_original: Race on all the 56 tracks from the original games Super Mario Kart, Mario Kart Super Circuit and Mario Kart DS.
home.face_off_cpus_14_grand: Face off with the CPUs on the 14 grand prix tournaments and try to win the gold trophy!
home.win_enough_cups_unlock_15: Win enough cups to unlock the 15 secret characters!
home.track_builder_possibilities_are_end: With the track builder, the possibilities are endless; the only limit is your imagination!
home.you_can_share_your_tracks: You can share your tracks or try other people's creations!
home.face_players_around_world: Face players from around the world!
home.win_as_many_races_as: Win as many races as possible and climb the official leaderboard!
home.make_best_scores_time_trial: Make the best scores in time trial!
home.finish_race_track_as_fast: Finish the race track as fast as you can!
home.compare_your_scores_community_face: Compare your scores with the community, and face other players' ghosts!
home.destroy_your_opponents_balloons_you: Destroy your opponents' balloons with your items, without getting hit by theirs!
home.face_off_your_friends_local: Face off your friends with the local multiplayer mode!
home.prove_your_friends_that_youre: Prove to your friends that you're the best!
home.face_them_multiplayer_vs_races: Face them in multiplayer in VS races or in battle mode.
home.click_game_box_begin: Click on the game box to begin
home.you_might_know_mario_kart: You might know Mario Kart, the most fun racing game series of all time! Mario Kart PC uses the same base as the original games but is playable on your browser, and for free.
home.most_modes_mario_kart_have: Most of the modes from Mario Kart have been included: Grand Prix, VS, Battle mode, Time Trials, and more!
home.theres_also_brand_new_mode: There's also a brand new mode: the track builder! Place straight lines and turns, add items, boost panels and more! Everything is customizable! The only limit is your own imagination!
home.you_can_share_your_tracks_try: You can share your tracks, and try other people's tracks thanks to the sharing tool. Thousands of custom tracks are already available!
home.finally_you_can_face_players: Finally, you can face players from the whole world thanks to the multiplayer online mode! Climb the rankings and become world champion!
home.here_are_some_screenshots_game: Here are some screenshots of the game to give you a quick preview of what it looks like:
home.big_thanks_nintendo_these_three: A big thanks to Nintendo, these three sites and these artists without which Mario Kart PC would have probably never existed!
home.nihilogic_mario_kart_original_poc: Nihilogic for the Mario Kart original PoC
home.discord_server_site_join_it: Discord Server of the site: join it to chat with the community and be informed about updates and events.
home.official_youtube_channel_find_video: Official Youtube Channel: find videos on the game and information about the website and its events. The channel is maintained by members, if you want to participate, tell it on the official topic.
home.github_repo_site_follow_all: Github repo of the site. Follow all the ongoing developments here, and if you can code, don't hesitate to contribute to the project!
home.mkpc_wiki_find_out_all: MKPC Wiki: find out all the information about the game and its history. This site is maintained by the community, if you want to contribute, tell it on this topic!
home.this_site_mostly_maintained_french: This site is mostly maintained by French members, if you see some translation errors in the game or the site, don't hesitate to report them on this forum topic
home.start_playing_its_very_simple: To start playing, it's very simple, just click on "Play game" in the menu above. Or more simply, click here:
